negative_findings.description: No Slovenian-bank-operated supplier registration / e-sourcing portal was located for NLB, OTP banka Slovenija, Addiko SI, Gorenjska banka, Banka Sparkasse or Delavska hranilnica, in either Slovenian or English searching.
negative_findings.result_summary: sl queries using nabava, dobavitelji, javni razpis, povabilo k oddaji ponudbe, and en equivalents returned only corporate/marketing pages, policy PDFs, or unrelated organisations.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell rationale: private-bank procurement in Slovenia is largely invisible in public channels and reachable mainly through parent-group portals or direct commercial contact, not through monitorable open feeds.

negative_findings.description: The acronym 'NLB' in English search collides with the UK Northern Lighthouse Board, which does operate a real procurement portal (nlb.delta-esourcing.com, nlb.g2b.info).
negative_findings.result_summary: An English query for 'NLB supplier procurement portal' returned exclusively Northern Lighthouse Board results and no Nova Ljubljanska banka results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A noisy term that will poison any automated English-language monitoring; NLB queries must be disambiguated ('Nova Ljubljanska banka', 'NLB Skupina', site:nlb.si / site:nlbgroup.com).

negative_findings.description: NLB's 'Javni razpisi' page — the most promising named channel — was fetched and found to carry calls for binding offers to buy distressed receivables (e.g. debtor succeeding Slimeks d.o.o. in bankruptcy), not supplier RFPs.
negative_findings.result_summary: One live listing, receivables-sale type; no procurement notices observed at scouting time.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents mis-scoring the page as a vendor-opportunity feed while preserving it as the correct watch point for any future NLB open market call.

negative_findings.description: No award/contract-award notice channel of any kind was found for private Slovenian banks in either language.
negative_findings.result_summary: Queries combining bank names with oddaja naročila / obvestilo o oddaji / award notice produced nothing bank-published.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Award-side intelligence for this cell cannot come from route (b) at all; it must be reconstructed from vendor press releases, references and case studies — a different workstream.

negative_findings.description: The Intesa Sanpaolo Portale Fornitori URL and the Erste Group Procurement page were identified from search result metadata and descriptions; neither was independently opened during this pass, and the Intesa portal's substantive content sits behind registration.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs recorded with confidence, liveness not asserted.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream verification must treat any 403/redirect as bot-defence or a login wall rather than as a dead source.

coverage_gaps.description: Intesa Sanpaolo Bank Slovenija's own site (intesasanpaolobank.si) was not directly crawled for a local 'dobavitelji / portal dobaviteljev' page, even though sibling subsidiaries in Serbia and Albania publish exactly such a page.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl intesasanpaolobank.si in sl and en for supplier/vendor pages and probe the URL patterns observed at bancaintesa.rs and intesasanpaolobank.al.

coverage_gaps.description: Bank career/RFI announcements, LinkedIn posts and vendor press releases — the practical 'reveals-indirectly' channel where Slovenian bank sourcing becomes visible (who won an IT/payments contract) — were not scouted in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated sweep of vendor and integrator press releases and LinkedIn posts naming NLB, OTP banka, Addiko, Sparkasse, Gorenjska banka and Delavska hranilnica as customers.

coverage_gaps.description: Annual reports / sustainability (ESG, CSRD) reports of each bank were not mined; these routinely disclose supplier counts, local-supplier share, supplier ESG screening and outsourcing arrangements.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Harvest the latest letno poročilo and trajnostno poročilo PDFs for all nine institutions and extract nabava/dobavitelji and outsourcing sections.

coverage_gaps.description: Regulatory outsourcing registers: EBA outsourcing-guidelines registers and DORA ICT third-party registers are maintained by each bank and reported to Banka Slovenije, but no route to any published extract was explored.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Investigate whether Banka Slovenije or the ECB publish any aggregated critical-ICT-provider or outsourcing statistics that would expose private-bank vendor relationships.

coverage_gaps.description: Parent-group sourcing channels for Addiko (Vienna), Gorenjska banka (AIK, Belgrade) and OTP (Budapest) would require German, Serbian and Hungarian search terms; only sl/en/limited de-it were used in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted de ('Lieferantenportal', 'Beschaffung'), sr ('dobavljači', 'nabavka', 'javni poziv') and hu ('beszerzés', 'beszállítói portál') queries against addiko.com, aikbanka.rs and otpbank.hu.

coverage_gaps.description: Bank-owned shared infrastructure beyond Bankart (e.g. Bankart's own supplier onboarding, and any bank-consortium procurement vehicles) was only hypothesised, not confirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl bankart.si directly and check company registers for other bank-owned service companies that concentrate payments procurement.

brief: Slovenia's private banks publish almost nothing about their own procurement: no bank in the cell operates a Slovenian supplier portal, and the one named channel that exists — NLB's 'Javni razpisi' page — was verified to carry receivables and asset sales rather than supplier RFPs, with Delavska hranilnica's /doc/obvestila-javne-objave/ directory being the only comparable local slot found. The actionable sourcing intelligence therefore sits at parent-group level: Intesa Sanpaolo's Portale Fornitori with its Supplier Gate qualification, Erste Group Procurement for Banka Sparkasse, UniCredit Services, and (unmapped in this pass) OTP Budapest, Addiko Vienna and AIK Belgrade. Governance texts — NLB's sustainability policy supplier-evaluation framework and OTP Slovenija's compliance policy supplier due-diligence clause — are the only local documents that expose qualification criteria. Practical monitoring should combine parent-portal registration, targeted crawls of each bank's corporate site, an e-JN name filter for opportunistic hits, and an indirect vendor-press-release sweep, since no award-notice channel exists for this cell at all.
